intent: Review the standalone voltage sensing plan and its new Atopile, Rust ERC, native evidence, and harness path. Confirm source-to-native construction checks while preserving explicit indeterminate status for physical qualification gaps.

findings.title: Standalone voltage CLI treats the intentionally indeterminate result as a process failure
findings.suggested_fix: Define the CLI exit contract explicitly. If this plan's milestone is construction-pass plus disclosed qualification gaps, return success when the report has no Fail findings and preserve status indeterminate in JSON; otherwise add a separate strict qualification command and make the existing command's expected failure explicit in its tests and Make target.
findings.why_it_matters: The real routed unit is asserted to have Status::Indeterminate with no failures in zapote/packages/zapote-harness/tests/voltage_sense.rs:11, while passed() returns true only for Status::Pass. Running the documented standalone checker therefore exits 1 for the intended healthy artifact, making command/shared-gate closeout appear failed and preventing automation from distinguishing construction failures from deliberately unqualified physical behavior.

actionable_findings.title: Standalone voltage CLI treats the intentionally indeterminate result as a process failure
actionable_findings.suggested_fix: Separate construction-gate success from physical-qualification status, or make the strict exit behavior and expected indeterminate result explicit in the command contract and tests.

notes: The plan explicitly permits qualification gaps and requires a routed construction-pass milestone.
Source/native/Rust checks and negative controls are present in the reviewed context.
The command exit behavior does not yet represent that stated completion boundary.

residual_risks: Physical qualification is intentionally indeterminate: ADC acquisition settling, hot leakage, transients, power-off/brownout, internal comparator hysteresis, and assembled insulation remain outside digital evidence.
The 250 V analytical envelope and nonisolated return architecture require integration review before cooker use.
testing_gaps: No command-level test asserts the intended exit code for a no-Fail Status::Indeterminate report.
No external physical or bench qualification was performed.
